pairsWith.noteUz: 'have got' mashqlari. Coursebook 13-bet Ex.8 bilan bir xil turdagi, lekin ancha ko'proq mashq beradi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in have, haven't, has, hasn't, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: have, haven't, has yoki hasn't dan mosini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
Ikki qadam:
1) EGA kim? — birlik (he/she/it) bo'lsa HAS, ko'plik bo'lsa HAVE.
2) Ma'no tasdiqmi yoki inkormi?

DIQQAT — millat nomlari KO'PLIK:
  'Jamaicans' (yamaykaliklar), 'Asians' (osiyoliklar) → HAVE
  Chunki bu 'they' ga teng.

'All my sisters' — 'all' bilan boshlansa ham ko'plik → HAVE.

items.textEn: A: Has Sue got blue eyes? B: Yes, she ___ .
items.whyUz: Savolda 'Has' bo'lgani uchun javobda ham 'has'. Qisqa javobda 'got' YO'Q.

items.textEn: A: ___ your brothers got straight hair? B: No, they ___ .
A: ___ Lisa got a big nose? B: No, she ___ .
items.whyUz: Lisa — bitta ayol → Has. Inkor → hasn't.

items.textEn: Erik is from Norway and he ___ got a fair complexion.
My mother ___ got long fair hair and green eyes.
Asians ___ got fair hair. They ___ got dark hair.
items.whyUz: Asians — ko'plik. Birinchi gap inkor (oq-sariq soch emas), ikkinchisi tasdiq (qora soch).

items.textEn: My father ___ got short curly hair and blue eyes.
All my sisters ___ got brown eyes.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the table and fill in has, hasn't, have or haven't.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalga qarang va has, hasn't, have yoki haven't dan mosini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
Jadvalda ✓ (bor) va ✗ (yo'q) belgilari berilgan.

Ikki qadam:
1) Jadvaldan tekshiring — ✓ bo'lsa tasdiq, ✗ bo'lsa inkor.
2) Egaga qarab shakl tanlang: bitta odam → has/hasn't,
   ikki odam ('Michael and Anna') → have/haven't.

DIQQAT — 'but' bog'lovchisi: undan oldin va keyin QARAMA-QARSHI
ma'no bo'ladi. Ya'ni biri tasdiq, ikkinchisi inkor.

items.textEn: Anna ___ got a cat. She ___ got a video camera.
Michael ___ got a car, but he ___ got a stereo.
Rachel ___ got a stereo. She ___ got a cat.
Michael and Anna ___ got a car. They ___ got a stereo.
items.whyUz: Ikkalasida ham mashina ✗, stereo ✓. Ikki odam → have/haven't.

items.textEn: Rachel ___ got a video camera, but she ___ got a car.
Michael ___ got a video camera, but he ___ got a cat.
Rachel and Anna ___ got a stereo. They ___ got a video camera.
Anna ___ got a car, but she ___ got a stereo.

exercises.instructionEn: Write questions and answers, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
Qolip uch qismli:
  1) SAVOL:  Has/Have + EGA + got + NARSA?
  2) JAVOB:  Yes, EGA has/have.  yoki  No, EGA hasn't/haven't.
  3) TUZATISH (agar javob inkor bo'lsa): EGA + 's/'ve got + TO'G'RISI.

DIQQAT — sanaladigan otlar oldidan 'a' qo'yiladi:
  a basketball, a guitar, a beard, a hat, a newspaper, a computer
Lekin KO'PLIK bo'lsa artikl yo'q: 'Have they got books?'
'hair' ham artiklsiz: 'Has she got dark hair?'

items.question: Has she got dark hair?
items.answer: No, she hasn't. She's got fair hair.
items.whyUz: Rasmda oq-sariq soch — savolda qora deyilgan, demak inkor + tuzatish.

items.pictureEn: a boy sitting with a basketball
items.question: Has he got a basketball?
items.whyUz: Rasmda basketbol to'pi bor — tasdiq javob, tuzatish shart emas.

items.pictureEn: a woman with long fair hair
items.question: Has she got short hair?
items.answer: No, she hasn't. She's got long hair.
items.whyUz: Soch uzun — savolda kalta deyilgan, demak inkor + tuzatish.

items.question: Have they got books?
items.whyUz: Ikki kishi → Have. 'books' ko'plik — artikl yo'q.

items.question: Has he got a guitar?
items.answer: No, he hasn't. He's got a piano.
items.whyUz: Rasmda pianino — savolda gitara deyilgan, demak inkor + tuzatish.

items.pictureEn: a woman working at a computer
items.question: Has she got a computer?

groups.ruleUz: Millat nomi KO'PLIKDA — butun xalq haqida
groups.explanationUz: Millat nomiga -s qo'shilsa, o'sha xalqning vakillari tushuniladi va KO'PLIK fe'li kerak (have, are).
Bu betdagi buyum nomlari ikki so'zdan iborat. Ular BITTA narsa hisoblanadi, shuning uchun 'a' bitta qo'yiladi.
Bu betda oila a'zolari ko'p uchraydi — ular Unit 4 da chuqurroq o'rganiladi.

sentencePatterns.introUz: 'have got' ning uch xil gapdagi ko'rinishi.

patterns.exampleEn: My grandfather has got grey hair.
patterns.explanationUz: Bitta odam → has, ko'plik → have. Millat nomlari (Asians, Jamaicans) — KO'PLIK.

patterns.formula: QARAMA-QARSHILIK: EGA + hasn't got X, BUT EGA + has got Y
patterns.exampleEn: Michael hasn't got a car, but he has got a stereo.
patterns.exampleUz: Michaelda mashina yo'q, lekin stereo bor.
patterns.explanationUz: 'but' ikki qarama-qarshi holatni bog'laydi: biri inkor, ikkinchisi tasdiq.

patterns.exampleEn: Has she got dark hair? — No, she hasn't. She's got fair hair.
patterns.exampleUz: Uning sochi qorami? — Yo'q. Uning sochi oq-sariq.
patterns.explanationUz:
Inkor javobdan keyin TO'G'RISINI aytish — tabiiy muloqot qoidasi.
Faqat 'No, she hasn't' deyish kam, chunki suhbatdosh to'g'ri javobni bilmaydi.

patterns.formula: ARTIKL: a + BIRLIK ot · artiklsiz + KO'PLIK/soch
patterns.exampleEn: Has he got a guitar? / Have they got books? / Has she got dark hair?
patterns.exampleUz: Uning gitarasi bormi? / Ularda kitob bormi? / Uning sochi qorami?
patterns.explanationUz:
Sanaladigan birlik ot → a/an.
Ko'plik (books) va sanalmaydigan (hair) → artikl YO'Q.
